WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        Consumption,
        COUNT(*) AS Count
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE Date = '2013'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment, Consumption
    FROM segment_consumption
    ORDER BY Consumption ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
segment_total AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment, SUM(Consumption) AS Total
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment, Total / Count AS Avg
    FROM segment_total
    WHERE Count = 1
)
SELECT 
    CAST(Segment AS TEXT) AS Segment,
    CAST(Currency AS TEXT) AS Currency
FROM customers
WHERE CustomerID IN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM segment_min_consumption
)
WHERE Segment = 'SME'

WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        Consumption,
        COUNT(*) AS Count
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE Date = '2013'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment, Consumption
    FROM segment_consumption
    ORDER BY Consumption ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
segment_total AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment, SUM(Consumption) AS Total
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment, Total / Count AS Avg
    FROM segment_total
    WHERE Count = 1
)
SELECT 
    CAST(Segment AS TEXT) AS Segment,
    CAST(Currency AS TEXT) AS Currency
FROM customers
WHERE CustomerID IN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM segment_min_consumption
)

SELECT e.event_name, e.event_date, e.type, e.notes, e.location, e.status, m.first_name, m.last_name, m.email, m.position, m.t_shirt_size, m.phone, m.zip, m.link_to_major, m.zip_code, b.category, b.spent, b.remaining, b.amount, b.event_status, b.link_to_event, b.link_to_member, e.expense_description, e.cost, e.approved, e.link_to_member, e.link_to_budget
FROM event e
JOIN member m ON m.link_to_member = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND e.event_date = '2019-10-08'
AND e.approved = True
ORDER BY e.event_date

  AND Examination.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND SEX = 'F'

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN League L ON T.team_fifa_api_id = L.id
JOIN Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
JOIN Player P ON M.home_player_1 = P.player_api_id

  AND M.date IS NOT NULL
  AND M.date >= '2010-01-01'
  AND M.date <= '2010-12-31'
  AND (M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal)
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

JOIN constructorResults cr ON r.raceId = cr.raceId

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN races r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year
JOIN constructorResults cr ON r.raceId = cr.raceId

sql:
SELECT r.name, d.forename, d.surname
FROM races r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE d.nationality = 'UK'
  AND c.name = 'Lewis Hamilton'
  AND cs.position = 1
ORDER BY r.name, d.forename, d.surname

    r.name,
    r.date,
    r.time,
    r.lap
FROM races r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors c ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
JOIN constructorResults cr ON r.raceId = cr.raceId

  AND r.time LIKE '00:00:00.000000'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM races r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors c ON d.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN constructorResults cr ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cr.constructorId = cs.constructorId
JOIN driverStandings ds ON cs.constructorId = ds.constructorId
JOIN lapTimes lt ON ds.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'France'
  AND d.number < 120
  AND lt.time < '02:00.00'
text:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM races r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors c ON d.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN constructorResults cr ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cr.constructorId = cs.constructorId
JOIN driverStandings ds ON cs.constructorId = ds.constructorId
JOIN lapTimes lt ON ds.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'France'
  AND d.number < 120
  AND lt.time < '02:00.00';
```

sql:
SELECT s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.CDSCode = (SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE Academic Year = '2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1')
AND (
    (SELECT AVG(ScrMath) FROM satscores sc2 WHERE sc2.cds = s.CDSCode) * 1
    < 400
)

sql:
SELECT s.School, s.DOC
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores s2 ON s.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
WHERE s.SchoolType = 'Local'
  AND s2.Enroll12 > s2.NumTstTakr
  AND (s2.Enroll12 - s2.NumTstTakr) > (
    SELECT AVG(Enroll12 - NumTstTakr)
    FROM schools s2
    JOIN satscores s3 ON s2.CDSCode = s3.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.SchoolType = 'Local'
      AND s3.Enroll12 > s3.NumTstTakr
  )
ORDER BY s.School
